record.paper_title: Conformally invariant scaling limits: an overview and a collection of problems
record.original_question: For dynamical critical site percolation on the triangular lattice with mesh ε, choose the flip rate λ = λ(ε) so that the correlation between a left-right crossing of a fixed square at times 0 and 1 equals 1/2. Prove that the scaling limit of this time-dependent percolation process exists as ε tends to 0. Also prove that crossing-event correlations between times t_1 < t_2 decay to 0 as t_2 - t_1 tends to infinity, and that changes in crossing events become unlikely as t_2 - t_1 tends to 0.

evidence.quote: Problem 5.3. Prove that the scaling limit of dynamical critical percolation exists. Prove that correlations between crossing events at different times t1 < t2 decay to zero as t2 − t1 → ∞ and that a change in a crossing event becomes unlikely if t2 − t1 → 0.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider dynamical critical site percolation on the triangular lattice with mesh ε > 0: each site is independently open or closed with probability 1/2, and each site independently resamples (flips with the appropriate probability to maintain the stationary Bernoulli(1/2) law) at rate λ = λ(ε), chosen so that, for a fixed square Q in the plane, the correlation between the indicator of the event {there is an open left–right crossing of Q at time 0} and the indicator of the same event at time 1 equals 1/2.

(a) Prove that as ε → 0, the scaling limit of this time-dependent random percolation configuration process exists (in an appropriate topological space of percolation configurations on the plane, e.g. the quad-crossing space).

(b) Prove that for any two times t₁ < t₂, the correlation between left–right crossing events of a fixed quad at times t₁ and t₂ tends to 0 as t₂ − t₁ → ∞.

(c) Prove that the probability that the left–right crossing indicator of a fixed quad changes between times t₁ and t₂ tends to 0 as t₂ − t₁ → 0.
artifact.status_search_result: Garban, Pete, and Schramm established the existence of the scaling limit of dynamical critical percolation on the triangular lattice (with the natural critical time-scaling) in "The scaling limits of near-critical and dynamical percolation" (arXiv:1305.5526; published in J. Eur. Math. Soc., 2018). They construct the limit in the quad-crossing topology, prove Markovianity and conformal covariance, and establish the decay/continuity properties of crossing correlations as time gaps go to infinity / zero.

status_evidence.title: The scaling limits of near-critical and dynamical percolation
status_evidence.snippet: Garban, Pete, Schramm construct the scaling limit of near-critical and dynamical percolation on the triangular lattice, proving Markovianity and conformal covariance.
status_evidence.claim: The scaling limit of dynamical critical percolation on the triangular lattice exists and satisfies the required correlation decay and continuity properties.
